Bret Weinstein is back with Rogan for episode 2198 of the Joe Rogan Experience. Weinstein, the biologist who co-hosts the DarkHorse podcast, returns to his standing themes: strange times, and institutions he says have been captured by the ideas they should test.

He gives Rogan his latest reading of science, media, and public health, in the long, careful sentences his fans know. Rogan, a friend, challenges him lightly and lets the case build. The episode is a dispatch for the heterodox, one more long entry in the record of a professor who left the classroom and kept teaching.
